usage: All PNGs share the same 1024x1024 coordinate system. Composite at x=0,y=0 with no scaling.

fit_adjustment.notes: The final PNGs include all scaling and alignment adjustments. Composite at (0,0) without further scaling. Final landmark targets and per-template transforms are in animation_alignment.

reference_mapping.portrait: large frontal portrait at upper right
reference_mapping.mapping: Base Y = 505 + (reference Y - 370) * (778 - 505) / (578 - 370); X = frontal face midline. Rounded to nearest pixel.

animation_alignment.notes: Coordinates are baked into each PNG. Eye anchors refer to the main eye socket bounds; closed eyes share the same socket. Expression shapes remain distinct. Mouth and all anatomical anchors are fixed. Blush may be absent. All overlays rebuilt and individually listed.

expression_refinement.reason: Align perceived eye line and keep angry brows nearer upper eyelids. Fixed centers alone do not account for expression shape.

blush_alpha_repair.marks: three original diagonal stroke shapes, no ellipse or skin-color patch

hair.method: Built-in imagegen texture removal; resized to original canvas; protected original skin, clothing, hairclip and silhouette alpha restored exactly.
hair.notes: ASCII mask uses white RGB with coverage in alpha, and excludes skin, dark hair outlines and hairclip. Runtime ASCII rendering is not included.
